summary: Verified Header profile icon replacement and new /stays/account page. All 11 flows pass: (1) /stays desktop+mobile show header-profile and NO header-signin-link; (2) homepage '/' does NOT render header-profile; (3) logged-out click on header-profile navigates to /stays/account and renders account-login panel with auth-tab-login + auth-email-input + auth-password-input; (4) register from account page transitions same route to account-page with account-profile/account-name/account-email/account-saved/account-booked/account-logout all present and name+email populated; (5) saved places via localStorage bds_stay_favs=['living-studio','kota-flat'] render listing-card-living-studio and listing-card-kota-flat under account-saved; (6) booking created via POST /api/stays/bookings (correct schema: adults/capacity/nightly/mode/stay_slug) returns 201 and reload of /stays/account shows account-booking-<id> with 'Confirmed' pill plus account-all-trips linking to /stays/trips; (7) logged-in header-profile shows user initials 'TG' and href=/stays/account; (8) account-logout logs out → account-login re-renders; (9) regression: no runtime errors on /stays/account (no 'Cannot read properties of undefined' pageerror observed), /stays and /stays/trips still work, mobile drawer-signin-link still present on /stays with href=/stays/account.
critical_code_review_comments: Account.jsx correctly passes `search` prop from useStays() to ListingCard, resolving the previous 'Cannot read properties of undefined (checkIn)' crash.
BookedCard links to /stays/trips/<id> with location state - good UX. Status pill labels covered (confirmed/requested/declined/cancelled).

Minor: 401 console errors visible on initial loads of /stays and /stays/account when logged-out (likely /api/auth/me probing) — harmless but noisy; consider silencing or using a lighter session-check endpoint.

success_rate.backend: 100% (booking POST 201 with correct schema; mine/me endpoints working)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Header profile icon + /stays/account page fully working end-to-end. Booking POST requires full schema (stay, stay_slug, mode, check_in, check_out, adults, children, infants, pets, capacity, nightly, name, email, phone). The current test month per prompt was Jan 2026 but the server date is actually Oct 2026 — use dates in 2028/2029 for future bookings to avoid 'in the past' or 'already booked' conflicts. drawer-signin-link href is now /stays/account (not /auth). No code changes required.
